Peter, Since I won my primary, people who've spent their careers in politics keep giving me the same advice: keep your head down, avoid tough questions, and save my resources so the TV ads can do the talking in the final weeks. We're doing things differently. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141211455/652806523/1733485175?refcode=em-10.11.26-all-2-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTA3Yzc1ZWUtY2ZjNS1mMTExLWJmNWItMDAwZDNhNGZiZTgzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=TWIrwnWrJXOkh2G1rXH8TQRUWifewJIvqwSARBPM8Mw=) I grew up working in my family's auto shop in Bakersfield. When I wasn't in school, I was there, and by the time I was a teenager I was doing oil changes and brake jobs on weekends. And it's why I know a cautious, fence-sitting campaign can’t win here. Washington consultants assume Central Valley voters aren't paying attention, when the truth is we've never been given a reason to show up. Families in this district have been overlooked by campaigns that talk at us through a television screen. Our team is knocking a record number of doors and having real conversations, because real trust here gets built _face-to-face_. And we're doing it without taking a dime of corporate PAC money, because that’s the moment you start answering to influences other than your community. **[With Election Day closing in, we are making real strides, but it’s crucial that we keep it funded. Our ad, "Lies," is the answer. But he has far more money than we do, and every day his ad runs without our response on the air, is a day voters hear only his side.

body:
October 12, 2026 | Read Online ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/mvuv25pr37u5hqr3993umhrrq05ggs3h9droq/g3hnh5hm0qveq0frh9/aHR0cHM6Ly9ja2FyY2hpdmUuY29tL2IvNHp1dmhlaHBvbTk5bWI2b3Z2ZW9sYTY2N2w4NXJpNWg0ZzB6bA== )

From Catherine
--------------

Hi Friend —

The headlines are enough to give you whiplash.

A few years ago, questioning election security got you labeled a conspiracy theorist. Now, the failures you were told didn’t exist are making headlines.

It’s becoming nearly impossible to know what to believe.

I’m weary of it. I suspect you are, too. And if we feel this way after years of paying close attention, imagine how it feels for someone just trying to make sense of the headlines.

For years, legitimate questions have been dismissed as "crazy conspiracies", and citizens — including many of us — have been discredited simply for reporting what we found or experienced firsthand.

Now we’re facing a tsunami of headlines about the very failures they spent years dismissing. What the mockbird media on both sides of the aisle buried a few years ago, they broadcast now* — and I believe the calculation is political: overwhelm you, discourage you, and convince you there’s no point in trying.

Do not let them get in your head.

Our election process has serious problems, but sitting out will solve none of them.

Believe me, I understand the anger. I’ve spent years in this fight. I know what it costs to keep going when institutions fail you, when the story gets twisted, when accountability always seems to be somebody else’s responsibility.

But I also know this: withdrawing leaves the decisions to whoever remains. And we are making progress! Yes, it's slower and far more difficult than in should be, but we are still moving forward!.

So - we have to vote. And we have to document failures, demand answers, and stay engaged at every level after the votes are counted.

Do not back down. We can still correct course. Do. Not. Give. Up.

And because you deserve more than another email telling you to keep fighting, we’ve built something to help. 🇺🇸 😊 🇺🇸

It’s called 7 Votes. And it puts a little encouragement, connection, and even fun back into showing up at the polls!

At 7votes.org ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/mvuv25pr37u5hqr3993umhrrq05ggs3h9droq/9qhzhnhde57g58u9h3/aHR0cHM6Ly83dm90ZXMub3Jn ), you choose seven people you know and help them follow through on voting.

Think about who those people might be. The friend who’s had enough. The neighbor who doesn’t think one vote matters. The family member who needs someone they trust to say, “I hear you. I’m frustrated, too. Let’s see this through.”

Be that person!

7 Votes makes it simple:

* Pick your seven. Add their first names or choose them from your contacts.
* Send a note. The app helps draft messages about checking registration, making a voting plan, and voting. Make them your own and send them from your phone.
* Follow through together. Your friends mark their progress through a link, so you can see who’s ready and who could use another reminder.

There’s a leaderboard, too, because a little friendly competition never hurts. And when your seven invite seven more, you can watch your reach grow.

It’s free. It’s nonpartisan. Nobody asks how anyone votes, just encourages your family and friends TO vote!

With 23 days until Election Day, here is something you can do today.

Let the people you know hear from someone they trust. Give them a reason to stay engaged. Help them take the next step.

We have too much worth fighting for to sit this out.

Keep the faith. Never quit. Ephesians 6 FTW!

Ever onward —

*From Above: To be clear, more headlines do not mean the media has suddenly committed to finding the truth about our elections. We’re seeing coverage of process failures and stories that hint at larger political scandals. But the biggest questions—including those we’ve spent years pursuing—are still radioactive.

Still, I’m glad these issues are getting attention. The problems are real, even when I believe the decision to cover them is politically calculated. Every honest report gives the public a chance to understand more and demand better.

And who knows? Maybe following a few uncomfortable facts will help some journalists find their way back to their own integrity.

I’m not holding my breath. But a girl can dream.

-->Stand With True the Vote ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/mvuv25pr37u5hqr3993umhrrq05ggs3h9droq/3ohphkh3kpwqpwbrhn/dHJ1ZXRoZXZvdGUub3JnL2RvbmF0ZQ== )
Stand With True the Vote ( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/mvuv25pr37u5hqr3993umhrrq05ggs3h9droq/3ohphkh3kpwqpwbrhn/dHJ1ZXRoZXZvdGUub3JnL2RvbmF0ZQ== )
We can't do this without you — and we wouldn't want to.

Thank you for your support!

What a week ...
---------------

( https://de717de0.click.kit-mail3.com/mvuv25pr37u5hqr3993umhrrq05ggs3h9droq/n2hohvhvl7dnlwh6hg/aHR0cHM6Ly94LmNvbS9UcnVlVGhlVm90ZS9zdGF0dXMvMjEwNjU0NTY1NDM3ODIyMTYyMT9zPTIw )

--------------------------

| | Friend, Thursday night was our first debate in Minnesota’s First District, and I walked off the set in North Mankato feeling really good.I’ll admit I’m a little biased. But I think folks watching at home saw a clear choice. On taxes, I told them the truth. If Democrats take the House, one of the first things they’ll do is repeal the tax cuts we passed and raise taxes on southern Minnesota families and farmers.On health care, Jake Johnson pitched what I would call by its real name: socialized medicine. Obamacare already broke our health care system. Doubling down on it won’t fix anything. And on the cost of living, I said what I hear at kitchen tables all across the district. We are still living with the hangover from bad Democratic policies.Here’s the thing, though. **A good night on a debate stage doesn’t win an election.** Outside groups have already poured more than $4 million into this race. That’s more than Minnesota’s U.S. Senate race has drawn, and most of it has been spent attacking me.Nobody spends that kind of money on a race they think is out of reach. National Democrats believe they can buy this seat. They will keep flooding our TV screens and knocking on doors from now until November 3. I’m not going to let our debate’s momentum go to waste. We need the resources to push back, set the record straight, and make sure every voter hears the truth before they cast a ballot. And folks are already voting.**Will you chip in today to help us push back?**

>> To win ALL 78 battleground districts.
| **Fellow Republican,**
**Pundits love to talk about the midterms like they 're a single nationwide election. **
**But that couldn 't be further from the truth. **
**There are in fact a total of 435 congressional districts across the United States, meaning there will be 435 separate elections happening at once! **
**And those elections are not all equally important. **
**[Of the 435 districts nationwide, partisan voter analysis from the Cook Political Report shows that only 78 currently fall within the competitive range of D+5 through R+5.](http://links.right-red.com/u/click?_t=7f2cc7f35be547959fee68a54bdac0d9&_m=fe33370d2c904676afdef6ae66bc7c4e&_e=aBKAa9_13NE4LwYmwshO3TbeB4G6GfVWwjwNq6tJl9UTBPml_zFbE_ts0BKPJenJMM778Q_l2SjO-hMJXBqNTCBoJnhVkxJvH644kBpXStz_66CTgtPQFkrAo3F8Kj41fngDycwxe9e3W6kJ9WxgL2IuMy1y5vbKq2XDabJKP_jIuOFziOyqfh53lTIjZCwiM_z2pFPH7zpIcLLGh_R9AlLQiEAqZWyLfpemW9R6EGZ22CARHDh2ye3DhbSRqgrW0br4vfOaMz8pjPgC6MhlNWpO7pxpl2BKI-sG9eTTv4atmUMytxz2oOR0xGzoSrkjywnULGZC6lFaRuQGGmyPFdN09uN3qh8X2cX6kXnkccxA2N3U4fXw_FnVpLYPBfNbZbvmk7gmg_m6Oj_jY1UoSrNId5-TTCUbMOUqXpHAwU8DwqxqXzjf_VY573RnQZtooC3YkkwODupcrMPvNnYaViGMfvxbDuAA3Rx09FizqxPuBWxlmYjHoeU5j4iqK3WY3duc1rj8Ec4xlisSkCARrajflfLZOe_YXmATu0oUuK3ginobFGdniN4OGPJZy3mDXoelT6xk7ZLP72T5N1JC2isa_8DMnhuTxhzQkizDQ-EvYVM3KyKv-pYH1LmI3m98VfUugyjNGxDGgGPvhDRPeJ72KhuhaeP9VhdmW4wpkkn5lxuM0WQbxMCSwgMnOL1ijqt_M-q1uz7wdrx9xqTnYDXOFoez3a9J74-Z6RzqO8kDuOwBuauKAhEfWf20loXW1rL56KEdPEm4pqtvlxgRZA%3D%3D)**

_You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. Peter, You can learn a lot about a politician by who can't stand them. So let me tell you who can't stand me: **Trump's MAGA Republicans can't stand me.** I've spent years calling out their agenda for exactly what it is — a corrupt scheme that takes from working people and hands it to billionaires. They know I won't stop. **Corporate PACs can't stand me.** I've never taken a dime from them. Not in my last campaign, not now, not ever. They know they can't buy me. So they'd rather I not exist. **AIPAC can't stand me.** I'm one of the only major Senate candidates in the country who has called for an end to sending U.S. taxpayer dollars to fund a genocide. They're already spending millions of dollars to stop campaigns like mine. That tells you everything about who I'm fighting for — and who I'm not. I didn't choose these enemies. They chose me because I refuse to play the game the way they want it played. Some politicians keep their heads down. They solely focus on pleasing their megadonors and always take the corporate-approved stance. _That’s why nothing ever changes._ That's not me, and frankly, the fact that these forces are already lining up against our campaign tells me we're doing something right. **But it also means we're going to need real grassroots support to fight back.** AIPAC won’t hesitate to funnel millions into Michigan to target our campaign. Corporate PACs don't play small. And MAGA Republicans want this Senate seat badly. The only way we match that energy is with people like you, Peter. Peter,

Horrible Hobbs has a four-point lead over conservative Andy Biggs in Arizona.

We can't trust every poll, but here's how we like to operate. Pray as though it all depends on God and act as though it all depends on us.

To put it simply, we cannot lose Arizona to Democrats in 2026.

Here's why:

If we lose Arizona in 2026, we don't just lose one election. We may lose the next decade.

**Arizona controls 11 electoral votes. Soon, it 'll be 12. Without Arizona, roughly 70% of the statistical paths to the White House disappear. **

>>> Whoever is the governor of Arizona will oversee the 2028 election. We need to win to secure the election.

>>> Arizona is the most consequential state in the presidential election. Lose it here, and 2028 gets a lot harder to win.

>>> Whoever wins the White House in 2028 runs the census. Whoever runs the census draws the lines for 2032.

That's a decade of ground we don't get back.

Here's how we win Arizona:

We win by deploying real people, knocking on doors, building real relationships with real voters.

It's having ballot chasers in the field every single day until Election Day.

We've done it before. Our ballot chasers helped beat a Kamala-backed city councilwoman here in Arizona. They delivered a win in the Salt River Project race against a wall of environmental spending.

And of course, it's how we delivered Arizona for Trump in 2028!

This works. We've proven it works.

Now we need to fund it at scale.

**Turning Point PAC is trying to raise $94,000 this week to put ballot chasers in the field across Arizona.**

Every dollar we raise goes straight to funding that operation: training, deploying, and sustaining the people who chase the vote.

---

We have to talk about this. What the President said this past Monday night is f*cked up. I’m not cursing for dramatic effect — there’s just no other way to describe it. In case you missed it: Monday night at a rally, Donald Trump suggested that Iran could hypothetically attack American cities — and that he would be OK with it. _“They can take out a city. Let them take out Los Angeles, let them take out San Diego. This is a very small price to pay and it’s going to be over very soon.”_ Since then I’ve received countless texts, calls, and emails from my constituents — many of whom are active duty service members, veterans, and their families — wondering if we’re safe, if there have been any credible threats, and if we’re under attack. So let me be clear: I have personally talked with our local FBI and military leadership, and there is NO increased threat to San Diego. You are safe. President Trump’s comments are inexcusable. They don’t need more context, and we don’t need a thicker skin to understand what he meant. San Diego and Los Angeles aren’t expendable, and neither are the service members who’ve already been killed in President Trump’s war with Iran or the ones who are still fighting this war. We need to end this war now, before President Trump decides that all Americans can be collateral damage, and we need to bring our service members home for good. Thanks for reading. More soon. Sara
---

This is a very small price to pay and it’s going to be over very soon.” Since then I’ve received countless texts, calls, and emails from my constituents — many of whom are active duty service members, veterans, and their families — wondering if we’re safe, if there have been any credible threats, and if we’re under attack. So let me be clear: I have personally talked with our local FBI and military leadership, and there is NO increased threat to San Diego. You are safe. President Trump’s comments are inexcusable. They don’t need more context, and we don’t need a thicker skin to understand what he meant. San Diego and Los Angeles aren’t expendable, and neither are the service members who’ve already been killed in President Trump’s war with Iran or the ones who are still fighting this war. We need to end this war now, before President Trump decides that all Americans can be collateral damage, and we need to bring our service members home for good. Thanks for reading. More soon. Why don’t I believe in setting term limits for Members of Congress?
---
Because elections are term limits.
---
“But, Beth,” you say, “the same people keep getting voted in, even when they are not fit to serve.”
---
I agree with that.
---
And the United States just went through a very weird time which I term, “Schrödinger’s Senator” when we didn’t know whether or not McConnell was alive or dead.
---
I say, “No term limits,” but I also say, “Members of Congress should be compelled by law to hold public, in-person town halls to which thousands of constituents attend and some ask questions live, on camera, to the legislator.
---

---

---
And the voters will share anything of concern, determining the fitness of a legislator based on real observation.
---

---
An informed voter is the best voter.
---

Together, we #ChooseDemocracy !

body:

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: WWYD?
body:
Greg Abbott is dumping $141 million into a failing campaign. Yikes.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
**If you had $141 million sitting in the bank,_what would you do with it?_**
Would you travel the world? Buy your dream home? Donate it to a cause you care about?
Or would you dump every single cent into a failing campaign for Governor? **Because that’s _exactly_ what Greg Abbott is doing.**
He’s outraising us, outspending us, and flooding the airwaves with lies about me. But despite burning through a mind-boggling $141 million, _he still can’t bring down this movement._
Greg Abbott is throwing money at the wall because he’s terrified of losing.
He knows that no amount of money can buy back the trust of everyday Texans who’re fed up with underfunded public schools, sky-high costs of gas and utilities, and his sloppy, corrupt leadership.
**But the truth is, we don’t need to raise or spend $141 million to win this race, Peter. We just need everyday people stepping up, pitching in what they can, when they can, to fuel this movement.**
If you have just $1 or anything to spare today, I promise that every single penny is being put to good use.
Your gift goes directly to funding our ads, billboards across the state, organizers on the ground, reaching voters, and powering our voter mobilization work to finally get Greg Abbott out of office.
**[So, Peter, will you make a donation of any amount today to help power this campaign in these last 22 days?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20261011_4_what.XJEKFJ&refcode=em20261011-2388&amount=5&t=1&akid=2388%2E299639%2Ei1OQR9)**

subject: A lost cause
body:
Let’s show the MAGA machine they don’t stand a chance in NC.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1635&source=&t=1&akid=4466%2E124072%2Es7N2CY) | | | | Peter,

Our final FEC public filing deadline before Election Day is two days away. After that, everything we’ve raised and spent since the start of this campaign will be reported publicly.
From the national news outlets, to Michael Whatley, to the far-right billionaires who have bankrolled his campaign, including President Trump himself – _everyone will be watching_ ...

... to see if we have the momentum to carry us across the finish line first on Election Day.

name: Scott Fitzgerald
subject: Three things we need
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Scott Fitzgerald for Congress
body:
Three things you can do to help us win in November.

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/9b8b5427a2de/the-next-56-days-matter-69028?e=561a28864e)
---
|
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/MsRzHx4LR9S?e=561a28864e&c2id=c7ba3a2bb578965816da09c04ea0f7a1)
| | | | |
---
| |

Friends,
Election Day is just 23 days away, and the stakes could not be higher. What happens this fall will decide the future of Wisconsin and who controls Congress.Here at home, every race on the ballot matters, from the Governor’s office to the State Legislature. In Washington, the House majority is on the line, and Democrats are pouring money into the fight to take it back. If they win, they will stop the work we’ve done to secure the border, cut wasteful spending, and keep more money in Wisconsin families’ pockets.That’s why I’m not taking a single vote for granted. A big turnout helps Republicans up and down the ballot here in Wisconsin and helps protect our majority in the House. I’m counting on you to help lead the way.**Here’s what I need from you this week:****1. **[**Chip in before our end-of-month deadline**](https://us.list-manage.com/zLA6TXX2dEL?e=561a28864e&c2id=c7ba3a2bb578965816da09c04ea0f7a1)**.**[ Every $10, $25 or $50 ](https://us.list-manage.com/AaZK9VoHxI3?e=561a28864e&c2id=c7ba3a2bb578965816da09c04ea0f7a1)gift pays for the doors we knock, the mail we send, and the ads that answer their attacks. Small gifts add up fast when we give together.**2\. Make your plan to vote.** Early in-person voting in Wisconsin starts **Tuesday, October 20**. Check your clerk’s hours and polling location at [MyVote.wi.gov](https://us.list-manage.com/yLvVrneRAtZ?e=561a28864e&c2id=c7ba3a2bb578965816da09c04ea0f7a1). If you vote by mail, send your ballot back very early. It has to be received by your clerk by 8:00 PM on Election Day to count.**3\. Bring three people with you.** Text a family member, call a neighbor, or invite a coworker to join you at the polls. Strong turnout here helps win races across Wisconsin and keeps the House in Republican hands.Representing you in Congress is the honor of my life. I’ve worked hard to keep our communities safe, our economy growing, and Wisconsin’s voice heard in Washington. I want to keep doing that work, and I can’t do it without you. I hope I can count on your help.Thank you for standing with me,
Congressman Scott Fitzgerald
P.S. If you’ve already voted, thank you! Forward this email to one friend who hasn’t yet. That’s how we save Wisconsin and hold the House. [Please click here to chip in today!](https://us.list-manage.com/U4ayElq0sRn?e=561a28864e&c2id=c7ba3a2bb578965816da09c04ea0f7a1)

body:
If we fall short, we can’t get our message out to every corner of Texas.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
We're almost there. We've raised $180,000 toward our $200,000 billboard goal. That's 90% of the way.
**We are just $20,000 from unlocking every dollar of our match, and putting up to $400,000 in billboards across Texas.**
This is your last chance to have your gift doubled. Once we hit our goal or run out of time, the match is gone. _If we fall short, that's matched money left on the table and billboards that never go up._
Early voting starts October 19, and roughly 70% of Texans will cast their ballots early or by mail. **We need these billboards up _now_ before those voters make their decision, so this is the moment.**
You've already shown me what this grassroots movement can do. I am grateful every day. Let's finish the job.

name: Peggy Flanagan
subject: Why I refuse to leave anyone behind
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tammy Baldwin for Senate
body:
[](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/6050?c0=em-ms-tb-20261012-flanagan.8k_kvK&refcode=em20261012-5731&amp%3Bamount=5&t=1&akid=5731%2E35263%2EYmxeVP)
Today is Indigenous Peoples' Day, and I wanted to take a moment with you.
I am Ojibwe and a proud member of White Earth. My family is the Wolf Clan. The role of my clan is to never leave anyone behind — and that’s been my guiding principle throughout my entire life.
Today, I’m thinking of all our relatives who survived residential boarding schools. I’m thinking of my father, who always spoke truth to power for the good of the Anishinaabe people.
I’m thinking of my daughter — who just got her first jingle dress — and whether or not she will see Indigenous women in all parts of our government.
Above all, Indigenous people are resilient. We have always been here, and we will always be here. Today, I’m celebrating that.
**_But even now, there are no Native voices in the U.S. Senate._**
It's high time that all our communities have a seat at the table. So I’m running to bring that resilience and strength to the United States Senate.
**[On this Indigenous Peoples’ Day, will you split a donation between my campaign and Tammy Baldwin to help us make history and build a future that serves all of us?](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/6050?c0=em-ms-tb-20261012-flanagan.8k_kvK&amount=5&refcode=em20261012-5731&t=2&akid=5731%2E35263%2EYmxeVP)**

body:
Each of us knows that there has never been a person more unfit to serve as Commander in Chief than Donald Trump.
#
Peter, this is Paul Eaton.
I served for 33 years in the United States Army and retired at the rank of Major General. I’m writing to you on behalf of VoteVets today.
Every year, my wife and I go to Arlington National Cemetery to pay our respects to the fallen. Some killed in action, some died of wounds, injuries, or illnesses related to service, some of natural causes at home. All served with honor.
Among them are my father and his co-pilot, shot down over Laos during the Vietnam War. They were missing in action for over thirty years, but now they are at peace together in that solemn and dignified place where the very best of our nation rest.
I’ve stood with my dear friend, Karen Meredith, at the grave of her son, 1LT Ken Ballard, in Section 60 where the fallen from the Global War on Terror are buried.
These are powerful, emotional experiences on hallowed ground.
Years ago, we first heard that Donald Trump called the fallen “suckers” and “losers,” confirmed by Trump’s own former White House Chief of Staff, retired Marine Corps General John Kelly. A man who lost his own son in combat.
Our fallen represent the best of our nation. They are not suckers, or losers.
Nevertheless, in 2024, we watched as Trump desecrated Arlington National Cemetery, mugging for the camera for a political photo-op in Section 60. At the time, I couldn’t even begin to comprehend it. Then, he won re-election. And now, he wants to build a gilded 250 foot tall arch, dedicated to himself.
These are dark times, indeed... but we are not without power.
With just a few weeks until an incredibly important election, we have a choice. Each of us knows that there has never been a person more unfit to serve as Commander in Chief than Donald Trump. But if we do not take back the House and Senate this November, he will have unchecked control for another two years.
It is on us to make sure that does not happen. I am proud to work with VoteVets, an organization that is spending millions in these final weeks to reach Veterans and Military Families before they vote. We will play a critical role in the defeat of Trump’s candidates.
And that is why I am asking you to make a donation to support our work.

Once and for all.**](https://act.votevets.org/go/2927?c0=vv-pac-em-oct26.xXsDMU&refcode=em261012-1-misc&t=1&akid=35683%2E3013755%2EE763qj)

subject: Indigenous Peoples' Day
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:
| | | [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/1102?refcode=em-header%3Frefcode%3Djtk1527-fr-nd&t=1&akid=13095%2E400544%2E0RHbsw)

It’s Indigenous Peoples’ Day, friend, and today I’m honoring the generations of fierce Pueblo women who made me who I am and who often were overlooked.
[**_I’m running to represent all New Mexicans and give a voice to those who don’t have one. With 22 days left, will you donate $5 to our grassroots campaign for Governor to help make history in New Mexico?_**](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/17392?refcode=jtk1527-fr-nd&t=3&akid=13095%2E400544%2E0RHbsw)
| | [Donate](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/17387?refcode=jtk1527-fr-nd&t=4&akid=13095%2E400544%2E0RHbsw)
---
From my great-grandmother to my mother to my aunties, and all those who came before them, I come from generations of strong Pueblo women who taught me what it means to serve others and fight for our people. **Those lessons have stayed with me my entire life.**
My mother, Mary Toya, embodied those values every day. She was born and raised in a boxcar, where members of Laguna Pueblo built a community far from our home. She proudly served in the U.S. Navy, raised four kids as a military wife, and devoted 25 years to Indian education at the Bureau of Indian Affairs.
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/17387?refcode=jtk1527-fr-nd&t=5&akid=13095%2E400544%2E0RHbsw)
Watching my mother and learning from the women who came before me taught me that where you come from matters. Our roots remind us who we are, who we serve, and the responsibility we have to the generations that follow us. It’s why I tell kids never to forget where they come from and why I believe everyone, no matter their background, has something to offer their community.
The women who raised me showed me what it means to be fierce in the face of adversity and resilient when the road ahead isn’t easy. They taught me to keep showing up, stand up for our people, and never stop fighting for a better future. Those lessons have shaped not only who I am but how I’ve chosen to serve.
That commitment carried me from Congress, where I became one of the first Native American women elected, to the Cabinet, where I became the first Native American Cabinet Secretary in U.S. history.
Now, I’m running to become the first Native American woman elected Governor in any state. While that would be a historic milestone, what matters most to me is what I can do with that opportunity: fight for all New Mexicans, defend our families, and make sure everyone has a voice and a seat at the table.
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/17387?refcode=jtk1527-fr-nd&t=6&akid=13095%2E400544%2E0RHbsw)
As a proud Pueblo woman, I’m committed to uplifting our people, leaving the ladder down for those forging their own paths, and building a government that truly reflects and fights for the people it serves. _But I can’t do this without the support of this whole grassroots team, friend._
[**_If you believe in moving New Mexico toward a future where everyone can thrive, then please chip in $5 or whatever you can spare to help me become the next Governor of New Mexico._**](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/17392?refcode=jtk1527-fr-nd&t=7&akid=13095%2E400544%2E0RHbsw)

name: Sarah McBride
subject: LGBTQ+ History Month
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
I’ve been thinking about the pioneers who made it possible for me to be where I am today.
# [](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1269?t=1&akid=3968%2E21716%2E01Wblz)
This month, as we race toward the midterms, it’s not lost on me that we’re also celebrating **LGBTQ+ History Month** — and I’ve been thinking about the pioneers who made it possible for me to be where I am today.
Some of those early activists marched when it could cost them their jobs. They testified in hearing rooms where no one wanted to hear them. They loved openly when the law said they couldn’t. And many of them never got to see the progress they fought for.
Growing up, I never imagined that I would have the opportunity to serve my state and my country as my authentic self. And while we’ve come a long way since I was a kid, I know that this is still a frightening time for so many in our country.
Donald Trump and MAGA Republicans in states across the country are demonizing transgender people, pushing bills to strip away our rights and erase LGBTQ+ people from public life.
**I want to be clear: Nobody should be scared to live their life because of who they are.**
Despite the cruel attacks, we must remain firm in our values and our vision in this moment. And just as importantly, we can never give up on our ability to win over more people to more fully see our humanity.
That’s how we grow our tent of allies, defeat the hateful attacks, and lay the foundation for freedom and safety for trans people in every corner of our country and every part of our globe.
For my part, as the first trans member of Congress to be elected, the way I can guarantee I’m not the last is to quite simply be the best member of Congress that I can be. To continue to fight for what’s right and for who needs it most. And to show that trans people are multi-dimensional human beings.
That’s exactly what I plan to do — and I’m going to need your help every step of the way.
Next month, we’re coming up on the first midterm election since I took office. If we flip the House in November, we can push back against Trump’s attacks and fight for dignity for _everyone_ in this country. But I need your help to do it.
[**Can you chip in $15 today to help us finish strong, flip the House, and protect the progress that so many people fought hard for?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/1580?c0=mcb-em-20261012-1.5WV6UB&refcode=em20261012-3968&t=2&akid=3968%2E21716%2E01Wblz)

Thank you,
Sarah

The Swing Left political team recently [updated the Immediate Impact Fund](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2631?t=1&akid=3112%2E1562180%2E3FE1PX)— which provides urgent resources for the most competitive races around the country that need it most—and we don’t want you to miss it.
The Immediate Impact Fund features 12 candidates and state committees where a grassroots donation right now will make the biggest impact in the last 22 days before Election Day. It’s informed by Swing Left’s political team, which is in daily conversations with campaigns for House, Senate, and governors’ races, as well as Democratic State Parties and downballot races. They chose these races based on rigorous analysis, including the latest polling data, fundraising reports, and direct conversations with campaigns about what they need revenue for right now.
This week, that includes Troy Jackson, running to flip the Maine Senate—a race Democrats must win in order to flip the Senate.
Jackson entered this race with just 101 days to go until Election Day, and his campaign is already competitive with Republican Senator Susan Collins, who has represented Maine since 1996. But Collins has won tough races before, and we need to make sure Jackson has everything he needs to win.
Jackson’s race is just one of the 12 recipients of this week’s fund:
[](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2631?t=2&akid=3112%2E1562180%2E3FE1PX)
[**Will you make a donation of any amount to our Immediate Impact Fund today to help these Democratic candidates and committees finish this election strong?**](https://act.swingleft.org/go/2631?t=3&akid=3112%2E1562180%2E3FE1PX)
Thank you for your support,
The Swing Left Team

**Since 2017, Swing Left has channeled the energy of grassroots volunteers and donors to elect Democrats, up and down the ballot, focusing on the most competitive races that can swing the national balance of power.** Right now, Swing Left is investing in grassroots organizing in key swing districts and initiatives across the country to flip the House and win the Senate and critical states in 2026. [**If you’d like to help support our work, you can make a donation using this link.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_sl_footer?refcode=em20261012-1&t=4&refcode2=3112_1562180_3FE1PX&akid=3112%2E1562180%2E3FE1PX)

name: Josh Shapiro
subject: My opponent’s strategy has worked before
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SHAPIRO FOR PENNSYLVANIA]
body:
[ stdin# ]Josh Shapiro for Pennsylvania
Derek, I’m sorry to
be so direct, but we’re really in a tight spot here.

According
to our records, you haven’t made a donation to our campaign yet*. I know
you probably receive a lot of emails like these — but your donation goes
an especially long way here in Pennsylvania, the swingiest swing state in
the entire country.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/17026?t=1001&akid=600%2E245147%2E_7wdbe ]Please, will you rush a donation of any amount before midnight tonight
to make sure we have the resources to expand our latest ad buy and fight
back against my opponent’s attacks?

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/17026?t=1002&akid=600%2E245147%2E_7wdbe ]Donate →

Here’s the latest updates from our campaign in battleground Pennsylvania:

Exactly one week ago, my opponent placed her first statewide ad buy of the
election — right at the moment voters are starting to pay attention.

Then, on the heels of last week’s debate, the far-right spin machine
kicked into overdrive, throwing anything and everything at the wall to see
what sticks. Lies, attacks, misinformation, you name it — and it’s not
going to stop until the moment polls close on Election Day.

Here’s the problem: My opponent’s strategy of waiting until the final few
weeks to open the floodgates isn’t misguided. It’s what Donald Trump did
less than two years ago — and it paid off.

Derek, this is
the moment we’ve all been waiting for. It’s the two-minute warning, and
we’ve got the ball. We’re driving down the field, and we’ve got the
momentum.

We just can’t afford a turnover. Not when we’re so close to the goal line.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/17026?t=1003&akid=600%2E245147%2E_7wdbe ]If every member of this team chips in just $5, we’d have the resources
to double our latest ad buy and make sure every Pennsylvanian who sees one
of my opponent’s ads sees at least TWO of our own in response. So what do
you say? Will you step up, chip in, and make sure Trump doesn’t get his
hands on Pennsylvania?

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/17027?t=1004&akid=600%2E245147%2E_7wdbe ]Donate $5 →

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/17028?t=1005&akid=600%2E245147%2E_7wdbe ]Donate $15 →

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/17030?t=1007&akid=600%2E245147%2E_7wdbe ]Donate $50 →

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/17031?t=1008&akid=600%2E245147%2E_7wdbe ]Donate $100 →

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/17026?t=1009&akid=600%2E245147%2E_7wdbe ]Other →

Thank you,

Josh Shapiro

*Our fundraising records aren’t always
100% perfect. Rest assured, if you’ve donated in the last few days, have
given under a different email address, or mailed in a check, we received
your donation, and are grateful for your support!

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with supporters like you.
Unsubscribe: https://act.joshshapiro.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1010&akid=600%2E245147%2E_7wdbe

On October 22, two weeks before Americans head to the polls to vote in the midterms, millions of patients who buy their prescriptions from licensed pharmacies in Canada are going to find out their medicine isn't coming. Not because of anything Congress passed or something President Trump campaigned on, but [because](https://substack.com/redirect/8476b238-e939-4375-95b9-2e2bedd4c991?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of a Customs and Border Protection rule that almost nobody in the Trump administration appears to have closely read.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/311d0a56-9426-456e-bd0f-6df48f6133f2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Under the title ["Indefinite Suspension of the De Minimis Exemption for Mail Shipments and New Postal Informal Entry,"](https://substack.com/redirect/61aaa1d2-ad1e-414c-b8c7-3600a26ad4a1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) CBP is ending the decades-old practice of letting low-value packages clear customs without a formal entry. From October 22, a 90-day supply of blood pressure pills mailed from a licensed pharmacy in British Columbia will need a licensed customs broker and a financial guarantee in the form of an entry bond, the same paperwork a freight importer files for a container of machine parts. No individual patient has ever been expected to clear that bar, and it will put a stop to the importation of more affordable drugs for American citizens.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/47ff14fe-f36c-4805-b6fb-f907c94e9c46?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
There are roughly 2.3 million Americans a year who, according to research published in the Journal of the American Medical Association (JAMA), buy their prescriptions abroad because they cannot afford them here in the United States. These are seniors on fixed incomes, the uninsured and underinsured, and working-class Americans. They are patients on Eliquis, one of the most commonly imported drugs, who pay less than $600 for a 90-day supply from Canada, roughly half of what the cheapest domestic discount platforms charge. They are school districts like Osceola County, Florida, the lowest-funded district in the state, which has kept its health plan solvent in part because employees could fill expensive prescriptions across the border.

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..QyWsETlEukMkYPSSP7iYmsRtpojf1EL29W3fdQJNock?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=219819415)
President Trump has made lowering drug prices one of the defining fights of his second term. He has spent political capital going after the pharmaceutical industry over the gap between what Americans pay and what the rest of the developed world pays for the identical pill. Personal importation from Canada is the single most visible example of that gap, and it is the one avenue ordinary Americans have been able to use on their own to escape it.
The pharmaceutical industry has hated drug importation from Canada for twenty-five years, but they have never been able to kill it, until now. Under the [guise](https://substack.com/redirect/c2c71892-941b-4d7a-8b66-1ddbdb86dea4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of a fentanyl crackdown, the new CBP rule would undo the drug importation opportunities Americans currently enjoy.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9e1bf1f7-f882-4870-9474-617d1939451c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The stated purpose of the rule is to stop illicit opioids arriving via mail, something every American supports, including the three Florida Republicans, Aaron Bean, Gus Bilirakis, and Scott Franklin, who [wrote](https://substack.com/redirect/c9953dff-ba8b-4679-9566-1de5f66efce3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to DHS, HHS, CBP, and the FDA on September 24 to ask why a rule aimed at fentanyl is going to land on their constituents' blood thinners. They asked for answers by October 2. They also pointed out that Section 227 of the Homeland Security appropriations law specifically bars CBP from using federal funds to stop an individual from bringing in a personal 90-day supply of a prescription drug, and in October 2006 DHS publicly extended that protection to mail-order purchases.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f1d22fac-a818-491e-a295-ceb126218386?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fd9d5b7e-8e68-45fa-b129-22ea9ed04a0e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The FDA's own Regulatory Procedures Manual [tells](https://substack.com/redirect/37c7d581-40ef-4a97-9480-200d4ce67472?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) its personnel they may allow entry of shipments when the quantity and purpose are clearly for personal use, and the product poses no unreasonable risk. None of that has been repealed, but a CBP rule is now about to override all of it. The only answer HHS has offered so far is that the FDA will continue to evaluate shipments on a case-by-case basis, but there won't be any cases because the shipments will stop.
One of two things is true. Either nobody in the chain of command between CBP and the Oval Office read this rule closely enough to notice it would cut off medicine to millions of Trump voters two weeks before an election, or somebody read it, understood it perfectly, and decided that was acceptable. The first is incompetence at a moment when the administration cannot afford it. The second is sabotage, and it has a long list of beneficiaries, starting with an industry that has spent the last year losing fights to this White House and would like nothing better than to see the President's drug-pricing agenda collapse.
House Democrats Mark Pocan and Jan Schakowsky are already [circulating](https://substack.com/redirect/7097fa54-2c7f-4459-9999-0208545fc2cb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a letter with close to fifty signatures that will let them claim the mantle of affordable medicine from the party that actually fought for it, the Republican Party. The people who allowed this rule to move on this timeline before the midterms either did not think about any of these negatives, or they did, and they wanted it anyway.
The President can still direct CBP to carve out personal-use prescription shipments from licensed pharmacies, consistent with Section 227 and the FDA's existing guidance, before October 22. He can ask who drafted this rule, who signed off on the effective date, and whether anyone in that process raised the obvious conflict with a law Congress has reauthorized every year for two decades. And he can make clear that a fentanyl crackdown does not require handing Big Pharma something it has wanted for twenty-five years. President Trump can ensure that Americans are still able to order their prescription drugs at a cheaper price abroad while also stopping the flow of fentanyl into the United States.
Before October 22, the CBP rule needs to be reversed, and we must find out who inside the Trump administration is trying to sabotage President Trump from within, because the stakes are too high this November and in 2028.

subject: I know you’ve heard it all before
body:
We still have a ways to go.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1641&source=&t=1&akid=4406%2E124072%2EOQ3h97) | | | |

Peter,
With a little more than 48 hours until our last FEC public filing deadline of the U.S. Senate race in North Carolina, I'm about to say something you've heard most every candidate say before:
**I need you to make your first donation of $5 to my campaign today.**
We've seen a surge of grassroots support since yesterday, and I’m so grateful. It's just what we needed to make major headway on our $3 million goal – but we still have a ways to go.
**We're currently on pace,** [**_but if you could donate $5, $10, $20 – or anything you can throw our way, really – we could close this gap with time to spare, and just focus on winning this race on Nov. 3._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1641&amount=5&t=8&akid=4406%2E124072%2EOQ3h97)

We're building a grassroots movement not just to take back the Senate for Democrats or put a stop to the cruel and costly agenda of MAGA Republicans – **but to return the reins of power in Washington DC to the hands of hardworking people.**
That means we have to go into this last three-week stretch with the resources to reach every North Carolinian online and in person. To fight for every last vote we can get. _To flip this seat blue for the first time in almost two decades._
So if you’re able to pitch in any amount now to help us make it happen, I’d really appreciate it. Here’s the link to donate: [**_https:/ /secure.actblue.com/donate/cooper_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1641&amount=5&t=13&akid=4406%2E124072%2EOQ3h97)

subject: Rep. Greg Casar and Sen. Bernie Sanders teamed up and introduced historic legislation to permanently ban artificial superintelligence:

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

It doesn’t take a genius to see where the current path of unfettered tech
greed is leading us.

Right now, billionaire tech executives and corporate leaders are racing
full speed ahead to build artificial superintelligence — systems that
could exceed human cognitive ability and act completely independent of
human control.

That’s why Justice Democrat Rep. Greg Casar and Sen. Bernie Sanders teamed
up and introduced historic legislation to permanently ban artificial
superintelligence, temporarily pause AI development, and create a federal
Department of Artificial Intelligence to strictly enforce safety
standards.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/em-20261012-ban-artificial-superintelligence-act/?source=em20261012-38344&t=1002&akid=38344%2E1203867%2EvcWY11 ]Now is the time to stop them before it’s too late: if you agree, will
you sign on as a citizen cosponsor of Greg and Bernie’s bill now?

While AI insiders warn of catastrophic risks and environmental devastation
— with 53% of Americans deeply concerned about the massive carbon
footprint and energy drain of data centers — if AI isn’t properly
regulated, Trump and his allies in Congress are going in the complete
opposite direction.

He’s resisted every call for oversight, openly dismissed the threats, and
focused purely on corporate profits over human safety. Just this week,
Trump welcomed Big Tech oligarchs worth $1.7 TRILLION to the White House,
at the same time that the AI lobby is on the verge of spending $300
million on this election cycle.

We can’t afford to sit back while corporate greed and political inaction
put humanity at existential risk.

That’s why Greg and Bernie introduced legislation to rein in the industry
and ban artificial superintelligence before there’s no turning back.

We know this bill faces long odds in a Republican-controlled Congress
beholden to corporate lobbyists — it’s why we need a massive wave of
public pressure to force lawmakers to take this crisis seriously and stand
up to the tech oligarchs.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/em-20261012-ban-artificial-superintelligence-act/?source=em20261012-38344&t=1003&akid=38344%2E1203867%2EvcWY11 ]If you’re with us, add your name to our petition right now to demand
Congress pass this bill. Together, we can put human safety, environmental
protection, and public interests over corporate profit.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/signup/em-20261012-ban-artificial-superintelligence-act/?source=em20261012-38344&t=1004&akid=38344%2E1203867%2EvcWY11 ]SIGN ON

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

## Trump Declares Ukraine Energy Ceasefire
President Trump announced Sunday morning that Russia and Ukraine had agreed to an immediate "[energy ceasefire](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFytCAcBPCnwe4c-OOBFhRfY3dfm9JBXD0ynBgger59xrxC6p357ex-PIaH9cGvy3_7gilzHFYcOaAUpAEr0nI62IzZJ2xxQ87facFAnNRN8JugwbridwyNrSYzAwRZwQjdCd11jZLV00hSTunOQolG3jWf9TiOnRxJqjtNmlfeXJ7gggTnDclakW1c21pM0joFzRqOyZeY6s_o1_LEHM64I9UuvqpgnqVsmcl_jHpG_XEc9Ti6K2PUX3MY9cHvYNS7L7Tp5O_31t5Llcy0HT4En9VVsbysD79k-eMTu6GfAAAA___jJ3Ki)," writing on Truth Social: _" Both parties have agreed. Do not break it!" _The White House gave no details, and Moscow had not commented. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky, who first said [the announcement "was news for me](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDGOpDAQRU8DmZFd0AYCB5uQ9aYbomr40N4xNrJNo779iBlpLjBJRaWn9_6_-3hn66xf__IGk5cwepzJIWfEER5xfU_ghMVG7GFHSkdcMZIkLZQUikaesn1hbLiczQIQ6hJGtb1q-77Rdfk0zU32vew6PT-WmnXbcb9g6m8k28dCWpXWXDwlFSkpG6orTdxMXceYa5402qKRmG0OsfofrM9PLO4dXojVFLbSmWfOeyrqPwUNBQ3neVY4YrhCroeChgtf0KDkdVRBw3eZ-EkTvEZgFg_kE_AiHilZFuxncXxEth4ix2PbReJ3KqOZ99M6Z5O-1NaNrftSyb9c8GXoMwAA__8aAYbD)," later wrote that Ukraine supports a ceasefire, "and it is important that Russia supports it as well." Hours later, Zelensky said [Russian drones hit a Kyiv](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0L-OszAQBPCnMV2QvfyzCxdf4y5feyXa2APxyQFkHFDe_sS9wjXbrDQ_zXzdxzvHFJf5P79gy7SOC849oRTkEQvy_PHgHVPM2NYN-_7OM0aS1N-UvCka2Zd4YGy5CnYCCE0FqwajBmPavqme1ncDdw8PHbQczMOgmXQg1RnfavWYUEV75SmpSEnZUlP3xK3XmhEa9j0G0UqEWNZcf69xKU9M6bMeyLVfX1Wyz1K2XTT_BDlB7jzPest8BL7e9ZsFOSyzIHdVE-QuTJBT8jpKkNOyG1pDglyVbdjOmFLc-0udXxzTr1L-OM5h6ScAAP__4xR2Mg) power plant and energy sites in the Kharkiv region after Trump's post. Ukraine's grid operator warned of power restrictions today. The announcement came a day after Trump said it was "[time for Ukraine to get a new president](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL-OrSAchJ9GOwz85PqnoLiN3bntLQ0HRmUXwQAec95-4yb7BNtMM8k3k-__Y35o511Y_-kdqixxDriyRylIMwLS-jbQGYtLOOKBnM-0YiZOHROcCZq1Ke6FWeraqgUgtDWU6EfRj6Ps2npTz6ckO2ohaSEjTT8aPvTizzgsox2Arnbq5gkuSHAuqW060tIMg4ZttenQV5LDuhJT8xFdKBsW_44vpMbEvfZqK-XIVfu3oqmi6bquxoSnucuKphtd0ST4T5R07gfL-p3Z-Zm0C2B5i6e3bEVhmgVc7EjIziKUZiu7r5Oyx-W8d7m7v6y7dv57u_xS2UvRVwAAAP__Vr-A8A)," blaming Zelensky for high U.S. diesel prices after Zelensky called Friday's Russian diesel deal a "gift" to Putin.
## American Among 13 Dead in Riyadh Strike
A projectile hit a terminal at Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport on Sunday, [a day after](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGu2zAQBNDTUB0NcSXLVsHCjVL9tAHSCAw5kjamSYFcW_DtA-cKvx5g8GZ-fc1fjiOn9ad7wMqS54SjRoigzEgo69vDVSxcsOcdtT7LiplaGrRptaHZeeEX5t41wS4AoWtgzWU0l3Hsh67ZrBn90JEZl_bsfbjS-WxgRvLA0l7oz7Vh--kzrSHTtj11p4Fc769Xh9A5P-Ci-haBJZfT38xJNizxnV8oJ58fTbSbyF5Vd1M0KZqO4zg9avpkiiYk7Z2i6TNL0ZRlQ1E0Vficgq5S-A69sVRd3TOwdlz2XES7RVC0IX3nGBG0bAXQsnFaq5as7ykfiiZX9O1G4ffz_qMpNuwHx8h1-IjXh-P4XyjfPPZl6V8AAAD__zjHj2M) a missile strike on the Saudi capital's airport killed at least 13 people, including an American, and wounded 309. The Sunday strike set fire to Terminal 4, and Saudi air defenses said they intercepted a cruise missile nearby. The airport [remains closed](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykULtuhDAQ_BroQPZiwVG4SEN3aVOixV7wJj6M7L1D9_cR-YV0oxlpXl_3-Y4ced8-8UFW1jTvdJZIIpRn2ilvb0dYaOVMRzqolGfeaAYFfaNVo2FGJ_yi2WDt7UoE1NVk9TDqYRxN39XBavR-GbXpVL8oXDtjxhstSKsDA4MxNdvLTysNWikDXdsDGne7IfkOXU9DZRR5lpTb78S7BFrjO70oty496miDyFGq7qOCqYLpPM_WLeXacekVTBesYArpKYFLIyETSlPw6blBzuVARw2KoPtpMr_Rh4s-UpYKpjpbf5wcI5f-KrI9kONfsPzzr5eF3wAAAP__lDeCmA), flights are being diverted, and Riyadh schools have moved online. Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis claimed the attacks and warned travelers to avoid every Saudi airport except Mecca and Medina. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said the attacks "[took numerous innocent lives, including an American citizen](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LFywyAQBNCvQZ09xwkhU1CkUecUSZGSOaNDJoOFBrAd_31G-YVsucXbmf06uzPFFNflnW5sW8hu5WdN3BoXxyuX5eWZKodYeMsb13ovCzsE1AcJB4mOfIsPdoq62QZm5L5jK0cjR2OU7rurHYaR1ajNoADUrHoAArwElhgUBeO7aHdPgkQJoLA_aiTlTyfiuSeveRQKeI4tl-N3jmu7ckiv_OBy9PnWJXttbauifxM4CZx-9lbg9Mn-436JWeBUG7V7FTihBAMjgIE9ctCD6Yqdt2dMKVa9Dy03iukPbv_842HxNwAA__9sJHHS)." President Trump said the U.S. "[may](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFugzAURb8GNkf2M4F48NCFLV07ohe4BlcGI9skyt9XVOoXdLnLlY6Oztd9uLMPfps_eYUtLg4bXjmgFKQBG9L8HsEZzifscUfOR5oxkKRWKCkUDTwW_8TQcD1ZBxB0Das6ozpjmlbXi72yk4472dCtnZiN1saY0Sh9bUh3hNrbk6ekIiVlQ_rSEjfj7caYNI8tuqqRmHyJ6fId_VYWuPCOT6TLGNc62KWUPVf6o6K-ot7FVI4N51dRf5Ir6pX8m5KOdRdHFi6mEVlkPiYvOPHDs3hxEj7xJpZ4lMWLhAdCFm-s2Crq62Sn_eVD8Lk9peaVffiVKP9s97T0EwAA__86QINM)" join Saudi strikes on the Houthis: _" We just found out about the recent attack, so we'll make a decision. We move very quickly."_
## American Dream Now Costs $5.3 Million
The American Dream now costs about [$5.3 million](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DHO4yAUBODT2B0WPAhJCopt0mXbLa0XGNusbLCAtZXbr5Ir_P1o5tP8eY5PjmtM82_e4NqUx4SzrmgNZURCmd8eXDHFgj3vqPVfmTGSJCuUFIpG9i0eGA33wU0AQfdw6npX1_vdWN0vTpLVMkz8sjrYC2u2wTC9bpq9V5JMH92nT0lFSkpDerDExt9ujKDZW1w7IxFiy2X4m2NqC6b1nQ-UweetX93S2l47_aujR0eP8zyHmA7UlneEyJ9QR4-2QHzZvKFEz0mEAt6Ez7WJEiuqMGJH8UhNKFIXo43tiwv7Gdc1VvtRzBvH9bvafnjW4eh_AAAA___sBn8L) over a lifetime, according to a new analysis of eight milestones: a home, two new cars, raising and educating two kids, retirement, healthcare, a wedding, pets, and a yearly vacation. That’s up 4.1% in a year, while wages rose 3.1%. The house is the biggest line at $1.28 million, followed by the cars and 20 years of retirement at about $1.2 million each. Raising two children jumped 9.5% to just over $700,000, the largest increase of any category. Child care drives much of that. Center-based care for two kids [costs more](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D3uozAUBPDTQGfkr4VQuNiGLttuiZ7sAV5kMLIdsrn9KrnCv_5JM6P5e5_vxJGP9Q_tcHVJ84FXiagVecaBvL49qGDhjDOdKOWZV8xa6l4oKZSeyVe-MFtqg1sADdPCqWFUwzja3rSb89JLo-2tD8EHI0GD_GW1seNoiEiZlt0nT0mllZRWm67XZP3tRgiGfI-hsRKBa8rdI_FRNyzxnS7kzqe9jW6r9SyN-d3oqdETH0vq_MYxeMqgF2V0Ka-NnnYEpkZPXxQfFWdmjyIyXxTFTo-UxZaeBVuKQeDfiaOgtNmF88Uxcuk_W9adOH676w8vu5z-HwAA__-3E4OL) than the median rent in every state with data, and more than a mortgage payment in most. Most Americans still think they’ll get there. [Sixty-nine percent](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLFyhCAURb9GOxx4sKgFRRq7TZvSecJTyaAwwO5m_z5jfiH1nbn3nvN1n-_ogz-3TzzI1DXOJ71KoFopz3RS3t6WsNDqM6WYqJRH3mgGDpoJzgTMaKt_0qywdWYlApItGdGPoh9HpWW7G6uUXHs9LG7QYuFSabFoyxfQHJdV3lpvrj7BBQjOFchOAyo7DEhOotXUN4qT8zXm7jv6s-60hnd8Uu5sPNpg9lpTaeRHA1MD0wXQbRjCI115A1OKITQw9ULAKBuY8KDsLZ7MZcKD0ekemQrDlHJEu1NhcOPsTZhLhyX9tNm49PIh-KKvL9uBPvxt138qexr4DQAA__-Ka4FJ) say they will personally achieve the American Dream, down four points from 2024, even though a college graduate’s lifetime earnings plus Social Security fall about $1.2 million short.

body:
Jake, Sarah, and Rachel are running to take back the House. We have 22 days to help them win.
#
Peter,
I think Washington could use a few more people who know what it’s like to teach a class, wait tables, and stretch a paycheck.
That’s why I’m proud to stand with these Small Town PAC candidates:
**Jake Johnson in Minnesota.** A public school teacher raised in a working-class family in Southern Minnesota. He’s running in my old congressional district to bring down costs, take on corruption, and invest in the places being left behind.
**Sarah Trone Garriott in Iowa.** A minister, working mom, and proven leader who put herself through college working at Walmart, waiting tables, and cleaning hotel rooms. She knows firsthand how hard it can be to make ends meet, and she knows how to win tough races.
**Rachel Wallace in Pennsylvania.** A lifelong Pennsylvanian and experienced public servant who knows how the federal government works—and how it doesn’t. She’s running to lower costs, fix our health care system, and make Washington work for the communities it too often leaves behind.
These folks understand the pressures working families face. _And every one of them is running to flip a Republican-held seat._
**[With your help, we can turn these opportunities into the wins we need to take back the House. But with just 22 days until Election Day, our candidates need that support now. Will you chip in $5 today to help Small Town PAC get them across the finish line?](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20261012-1.JEn1qC&amount=5&refcode=em20261012-1200&t=1&akid=1200%2E34582%2EJ7CAEj)**

body:
this is ours to win
This November is all or nothing for the Left. And they're counting on patriots like you to stay home.

| | | | Peter,
---
Let me tell you why we're fired up about this November... Because 2026 is all or nothing for the Left. If they don't win the midterms, they know they'll be out of power for at least a decade. And right now, most polling in every swing state is a coin flip. Within the margin of error, either way. When it's that close, only one thing matters -- **_turnout._** Charlie Kirk built Turning Point Action to be the ballot-chasing machine that tips the scales in races like these. In 2024, we went 10 for 10. Every state we worked, President Trump won. **The formula is simple: Knock more doors. Chase more ballots. WIN more races. ** It's what Charlie called "the clipboard and tennis shoes" work to reach every voter. It's not glamorous, but... it's the work that wins. **And right now, Charlie 's machine is on the ground chasing ballots in Arizona, Nevada, and New Hampshire. ** If we win these states, we can lock the Left out of power for a decade -- if not for a full generation. _That 's why we're reaching out to you today... _ Every day, we're churning out new classes of trained ballot chasers to go door-to-door in these key states. ## Protesters Rally Against Death Penalty
Families, activists, and exonerated former death row inmates [rallied at the Texas Capitol](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL3unDAQxJ8GOiOvj-OjcJGG7tKmRIu9wCrGRngDd28fca_wb0ej-c3Mn9f4Qg4cl9-4kZX3nMZIVw4kQsd4JPeXJGP0G56Zo1s54kLpGI02jQKtwIzohE8aayy9nbTvoSQLbQ-dNj08y9VOpuk9Ulf73t_qPLvO40yuayYwTyjZ3nGgwQBoqNsK0LvJd_1kdN_N06OoNXmWdFSyktAb8xw-6aSjcmkrg11F9lw8fhVmKMxwXVc1p3eL_7JwvC2FGe5VhRm-ZTlLVgeG8FG4IMcsyhPKqnaKGOSjvgjlcGdJoTys3y8OgXPTFrVeNuTwBctPDzut-R8AAP__JYyEQQ) on Saturday, marking 27 years of organized opposition to capital punishment with a march demanding an end to executions in Texas and nationwide. John Lucio pleaded for his mother, Melissa, who has been on death row for nearly two decades since a jury convicted her in her 2-year-old daughter's 2007 death. Last month, the state's highest criminal court [rejected a lower court's finding](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLuu4yAQhp8Gd0TM2PGloNiG7my7pTWBIUYHgwUoPnn7lfMKp5359f2Xf1_rF4UY0vMv7azbj89r4rNGbo3LWrL95lYpuZ1eNSS7hURPzmVFhaMEJQFXsi28eB2oc_qh3AIda5gWmBUucO82DVZ5oF7dJxrRu8lZhwSjRe_uxOy7oC8cKEAABcN0A3L24eblgWqZ_aMXg2IXWi63tnHjH6o-vvOLy83mvYt6a-2oov8j0Ag053nevjnV-_UVaKi0YCMLNFc1gSZmS1Gg-ZAEGsfUNnlwotjeMh9HTpxalTsVu8mPSj4vu5TLdU015CTQ4LhIIN9P8zBKNcxKDsgsqUcllxEVLW4k3_uuaHecIcZQx0kM6rlTiJ_o7beTvzT-DwAA__-qJpa1) that she was innocent. Outside the gates of Fort Hood, the national group [Death Penalty Action protested](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOnDAQhJ_GdD7ZizG4oEhD96dNiRZ7Oazz2chs4L-3j4jyBmlnRqOZ79fX_IUxxfz8iW8a-Xstc6brSMRMda7Fv4gPzOGN5xGz32LGJ5U6gwIrtZIaZvQcT5oNNmFcVHC6oVH3Tg8KnO6abXTerq1ZF9N3qlc24LB25AHCok2_2KGJ412nlQatlTb9Q2PwSxjcAsoN69IKoyhELvXBGzF947GmTzmpPnx5N2ncmPdDtD8ETAKm67oeL0-Zz9sWMGHl6BMJmO5vAqZUPCYB014L08G3hJmjDIS8yZ0yJv7IZy2_d7mVFA75LylfMSWiLGDqlJK4eqs7bGUw1kuDWklnbSv74JVbMSx965o6hv2KKcXD9sKo5xtj-rub_5f3OcKfAAAA__83iJVl) the scheduled Dec. 3 firing squad execution of Nidal Hasan, the gunman in the 2009 shooting on the post. President Trump said Saturday he will "make a decision ultimately" on [whether to livestream the execution](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0L2OqzAQhuGrgc7IdjgQFy5OQ5dtt0SDPYRR_BPZE0jufsXewtav9Gjm-77NN6BA6f4FES2_1zwnPGpAZixzye6BXCH5CHul5DZKcMdcZi31IJQUSs_gmHace2i9XaQ3qkWrRqOuUhv1r90sgHfGD0MPvh-NGr1yxlwkrKNZ_LpgS_bklFRaKan6sVPg3eKvZtHSXNfl0vQSPXEuHW_I-Ia6hk_esXQuxzbYjflZm8v_Rk-Nno7j6B5c4xkbPZ3_NHri8opPUeFTxYbioBDEKzBFYAwfEeGBwqOjSjmJnMSaC4stZy_qljNjEfhG9-IzB9qxckE4-bZY_zw5qsPY9PIegcLvXfzXPXerfwIAAP__H5mP2Q), a plan that drew criticism from Republicans and Democrats. ## Projected Cold Front Inbound
A [cold front is forecast](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGupDAQRE9jMpDdMBgCB5uQzaYbosZuBmuNjewWzNz-i7nCj6v0SvX-Pecn-uDj6y_uZPi9pjnSVQIxU55zsv-JC0a341l8tJuP-KKUZ5DQ10rWCma07E-aO6ycWaQbVUVG6VENEkb1qDajtV0W6GnRY0-aurZ1j8faKTe4frBaVt7cOCUVKCVVpxuFzi5uGBeQ47AuregkOc8pN7wR0xvLGj7ppNzYtFfBbMxHEe0fAZOA6bquZv8UjBg5RZ_ukoDp_nWnhLxRFjBhZm8DCZhsCq5ec4pcf-k1QKehbcfm2I4qG3dcPgRfei06-drRh-8w_1bYaeAnAAD__6NQgVs) to push into the Panhandle and West Texas tonight, dropping Lubbock from weekend highs in the mid-90s to lows in the 50s by Wednesday. The [front will collide](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykULGOgzAU-xrYgpJACwwZbunWW29Ej7wXiC4kVfIK7d-f2n7CLZZsWZbtn-t0BR98XL5hI8MPl6ZIRwnETHnKyf4SF4i4wV58tKuPsFDKk5b6LJQUSk9g2e80dVCjmSWOqiaj-lENUo_qVK9GYosjKYmzHHDuTjC4Xmvr0HbYnhzV3rzilFRaKam6vlGAdsZhnLUcBze3VScJPafc8EpMDyguPNNOubFpq4NZmW-lar8qfan05TiOxqXHQcDrx_ISP0y81lX6kmmLELmI9Z6ztxBJFL-lKLZ78IzwFC6khILXTMBieeMtgI-lzgZvhw_Bl3NfdXLZwId3Ef7vgbvRfwEAAP__D_GKyQ) with the remnants of Pacific Hurricane Simon on Tuesday, bringing a Level 2 (out of 5) severe storm risk to the Panhandle. The National Weather Service warns of golf ball-size hail around Lubbock, 60 mph winds, and a slim tornado chance into Wednesday morning. Central Texas stays hot and muggy, with heat index values in the low triple digits, until the [front reaches Austin](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLEO2yAURb8Gb1jwQmMzMHTxlq4drWd4DigYIvxiu39fpb_Q8epKR0fn92N-YMqpPH_hRo6vtc6Fzj0TM7W5Vf8i3rGEDY89FR9TwSfVNoOCu9RKapjRczpoNtgFt6hgdUdOD1aPCqz-0UU3-ttiw0gBgIbBhMWrMRi_WLJg0JguuS9OKw1aK22GXmPwSxjtAsqO63ITRlFIXFvPkZgu3Nf8px7Uel-3LrvI_N7F7aeAScB0nmf_urB8z-8k5EhNwLTWRh53FjDFyhJLkPGzpSA_hVOWHEkWulj6moNcWy0sMzLJk-glYOqaC-8z5Zz2-yCMem6Y8j8D_t9yh4O_AQAA___0I4Xg) late in the week. Highs should settle into the upper 70s behind it, with cool, dry mornings.

Can Philadelphia become America's next Mississippi Miracle?
On **Saturday, October 24** , I'm bringing our 2nd **Annual F3 Forum: Faith • Family • Future of Education in America** to Germantown for a conversation about what our children need--and what we can do to help them succeed.
We'll explore what Mississippi changed, what success should look like for every student, and how parents, schools, pastors, and communities can help build it.
You'll hear from **Corey DeAngelis, Daniel McGrath, Dr. Lawrence Jones, Leah Ferretti, Brad Anderson, Joe Watkins, Dom Giordano** , and community voices confronting these challenges firsthand.
Come with questions. Leave with the vocabulary to advocate well for our children.
**Saturday, October 24, 2026**
**9:00 AM -2:00 PM** * Doors open at 8:30 AM
**Braid Mill, 441 E. High Street, Philadelphia, PA 19144**
**Caribbean fusion lunch provided**
We've intentionally kept the cost low. **Germantown residents, pastors, and teachers may attend at no cost --but everyone must register.**

clean_body: Patriot, This is worrisome. Katie Hobbs is polling at 39%. Andy Biggs is at 37%. We 're closing the gap, but we have less than 45 days left on the clock. Arizona is THE battleground state. Here's what's at stake: If we lose AZ this year, we risk not having secure elections in 2028. We risk losing the Presidency. * We risk losing a decade because the next president will conduct the 2030 census. This is not to be alarmist. This is an all-hands-on-deck moment. We cannot lose Arizona. Closing a six-point gap in 45 days requires hard work. It happens by going door to door, meeting voters, and counting every ballot. We have the ballot chasers ready, but we're coming up short on funds. We're raising $94,000 this month to keep Turning Point PAC-funded ballot chasers in the field across Arizona every single day between now and Election Day. We can still win Arizona. But not without you. For America and for Charlie, Tyler Bowyer Executive Director Turning Point PAC Arizona Paid for by Turning Point PAC Arizona. subject: We are in the last stretch of this race and need your help!
body:
Hi everyone, We're a few weeks out from Election Day, and I need some help. We don't have the millions that my opponent has to spread our message, so we're counting on volunteers to get the word out. There are two ways you can pitch in: 1. Put up a yard sign. We can drop one off at your house. 2. Knock on doors. We'll give you a list of addresses and some literature to hand out. Even one afternoon helps. If you're interested, sign up here: https://www.marysilvaforcongress.com/volunteer Or just reply to this email and let us know what works for you. Thank you for being part of this. -Mary

Hey Friends!I’m reaching out to you to make sure know that Knoxville has an amazing opportunity to flip a red seat to BLUE! House District 18 is ready to become a Democratic seat with Bryan Goldberg. He is out on the trail wearing out his shoes as he travels the district listening to voters. Did you catch that? He is LISTENING to voters, not talking AT them. He wants to hear from everyone in the district, a new concept for HD18 constituents under the current representative.

Bryan is a husband, a father, a manager, a community leader, and was a gold medal swimmer at the Pan Am Games—every aspect of his life is about working with a team. You can learn more about Bryan by going to his [website here!](https://us.list-manage.com/5_vgDhJ1Pyy?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0) The Republicans know HD18 is at risk because they have been sending their leadership into the district and it isn’t working for them because Bryan is talking with everyone about the issues that are important to their families. He will work for affordable healthcare, child care, groceries, and great public schools for all our kids.

Together, we can flip this seat, but we need you on the team.
You can [CLICK HERE ](https://us.list-manage.com/ClaW95RycFV?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)to donate whatever you can.

If we all work together, we can flip this seat for Tennessee families!
In Solidarity,
Rep. Gloria Johnson

| | Dear Friend,

Have you noticed how hard it is to make sense of arguments today?

Confident claims, especially with talking heads on television...quick reactions in comments online...everyone with strong opinions but not always clear thinking.

That's why we put together a **free Logic and Rhetoric Guide** --to help you think more clearly, evaluate the various opinions you hear and read daily, and make stronger, more persuasive arguments.

**You can download your free Logic and Rhetoric Guide here:**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/logic-rhetoric-study-guide**](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckcFq3DAQhp9GvtloRl579-BDqXeh0KSUHHo0Ws3YHpAlI8kJefuSkH2BXL-Bb_6f_9_T9GTFS1ie7caD5DxRpIniW_DR0ns80pyYfVzE2UBpQo1dDboGnKwr8spTaysaTgjn-VzxAP0Fzro7mUu1DrPGO0B_b4lnc241APasL5eZAXXHp0qGDx9oQECN0DcIrbvbmQwbdnoG1epjJ1u4kZCFOLsY9z16KeJyE9NS-WEtZc_K_FB4U3iTMMdmFe8zWc8N06Hw9pm_TiuXmMTVuRz0Xi-HECtzy06ZUWPf62eNLf6-juOf8Xr9qbA7yjbleCTHyox7inlnVyQsX6eNSY5NmZE3K_4LOrvtVpagzPj59oFjKByKMuPfvv718lI_mldpoP1NvJfc9arVy4ercXGrynf3eB3wfwAAAP__xD6bZQ)

Inside, you'll discover how to:
* Recognize when an argument is sound, or when it falls apart

* Distinguish facts from opinions and emotional appeals

* Think more clearly before reacting

* Express your ideas more clearly and persuasively

In short, your guide will help you do something that's becoming increasingly rare: **Think clearly --and speak with confidence.**

And it's not just theory (although there's a lot of that in the guide)!

These are practical tools you can start using right away...in conversations, while watching the news, and in daily decisions.

**The guide is completely free, and you can read it at your own pace.**

And, if you want to go deeper, you can continue learning in Hillsdale College's full FREE online course, **" Classical Logic and Rhetoric."**

Trust me, the guide becomes even more helpful when you see these ideas explained by a Hillsdale faculty member in the full course.

**So, download your free Logic and Rhetoric Guide now:**

[**https://info.hillsdale.edu/logic-rhetoric-study-guide**](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckcFq3DAQhp9GvtloRl579-BDqXeh0KSUHHo0Ws3YHpAlI8kJefuSkH2BXL-Bb_6f_9_T9GTFS1ie7caD5DxRpIniW_DR0ns80pyYfVzE2UBpQo1dDboGnKwr8spTaysaTgjn-VzxAP0Fzro7mUu1DrPGO0B_b4lnc241APasL5eZAXXHp0qGDx9oQECN0DcIrbvbmQwbdnoG1epjJ1u4kZCFOLsY9z16KeJyE9NS-WEtZc_K_FB4U3iTMMdmFe8zWc8N06Hw9pm_TiuXmMTVuRz0Xi-HECtzy06ZUWPf62eNLf6-juOf8Xr9qbA7yjbleCTHyox7inlnVyQsX6eNSY5NmZE3K_4LOrvtVpagzPj59oFjKByKMuPfvv718lI_mldpoP1NvJfc9arVy4ercXGrynf3eB3wfwAAAP__xD6bZQ)

It's our gift to you. Part of our educational mission is to help more and more people understand what's true and communicate it clearly.

We hope you find it helpful.

Warm regards,

Bill Gray, '01

Hillsdale College

Americans are mad. It's showing up in the numbers and anywhere you look. 55 percent of Americans think their personal finances are deteriorating. People can't save money. Inflation is stubborn. Real wages, adjusted for inflation, have been negative since April of this year, a span of 6 months.
This is translating to deep dissatisfaction with Trump, Republicans and the folks currently in power. One commentator noted that Trump ran on 3 promises: curbing inflation, enforcing immigration laws (without shooting Americans) and no new wars. "Even the densest voter can tell when you go 0 for 3." The war in Iran is an easy thing to blame for elevated gas prices. It doesn't help that Trump seems way more preoccupied with personally profiting and building ballrooms than actually making progress on any of the above issues. His approval rating stands at a dismal 32%. This is WAY below the water line and historically aberrant.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/39fc12f1-b40a-46f8-af0a-df419827dcd0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Midterms are almost always bad for the incumbent party even when things aren't quite this extreme. Throw in AI shaking Americans' sense of the future and you get a recipe for blowout losses, even though the map favored Republicans going in, particularly for the Senate. Democrats have hopes of winning in states like Texas, Iowa, Ohio and Kansas, and Republicans recently spent some money in ruby red South Carolina defending the Senate seat there (our old friend [Jermaine Johnson](https://substack.com/redirect/0c6133b5-a5fc-4195-acb0-27836a8e6a83?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) is running for Governor in SC and making a push too). Even states like Idaho and South Dakota are in play because the Democrats stepped aside and let [Todd Achilles](https://substack.com/redirect/6ba3791b-c53b-48a0-9f9d-07b5dac80491?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [Brian Bengs](https://substack.com/redirect/0a91bf7a-69c1-4df9-98f9-fb9e9138cec7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) challenge for the seats; each has raised over $1 million in previously noncompetitive states and is polling neck-and-neck with the 83-year-old and 72-year-old incumbents.
Republicans were hoping that their money advantage would insulate them from challenges; they had a $125 million to $15 million advantage between the RNC vs. the DNC for example. Trump's PAC reported $415 million on hand, a massive war chest. But the money gets spent on ads and people still don't like them. Campaign spending is a funny thing; it can amplify your message and clue in uninformed voters. It can elevate the negatives of your opponent. It can introduce you. But if voters are mad enough, they can figure out who the incumbent is.
By the way, worth noting is that to the extent big money is being spent by the Dems, it's on Congress. Competitive gubernatorial races in places like Florida (and another old friend, [David Jolly](https://substack.com/redirect/b16886a8-10fc-4f73-ac4b-514b9eeda7ff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) are being neglected by the megadonor class. Getting Dems to try and put a check on Trump is an easy sell. Much harder to care about flipping Tallahassee, though these two things are going to intersect eventually. Republicans have been better at winning state races while Democrats are somewhat fixated on D.C.
People ask me all the time how I think it plays out. I do think we are going to see a breakthrough in one or more of the red states; I've met James Talarico (Texas), Adam Hamilton (Kansas) and Sherrod Brown (Ohio) and can easily see them winning their races. I think you're going to see an Independent Senator emerge, whether from Idaho, South Dakota or Nebraska, which will be an enormous deal. Democrats are poised to have a great night on November 3rd from a national perspective. I see them winning the House and achieving a 50-50 Senate or even a slight majority, which would represent a gain of several seats.
The main unanswered question then becomes, "Will the Trump crew actually acknowledge defeat and hand the keys of Congress back to the Dems?" It's hard for me to see that happening. We are well beyond the "Well, we got shellacked, we'll get them next time" version of American politics. The current identity of the Republican Party is that their opponents are degenerate threats to the country, and you don't surrender power to those sorts of people over something like a vote total. Maybe the votes are a hallucination. My fear for years has been a muddied process, accusations of fraud, a failure to seat winners, invocation of security threats and the like. A fog of mistrust is descending. I'll be pleasantly shocked if the January after the midterm is clean and orderly.
Our institutions aren't exactly clicking - more like hanging on by a thread or dissolving before our eyes.
Let's say the election stands up and Congress does revert to the Dems - what gets done? I'd expect very little happens legislatively as Republicans would still be able to filibuster from the Senate and Trump could veto anything he doesn't like. The Dem 2028 field will start declaring itself shortly after the midterms, and the political spotlight will then turn to them. Kamala Harris recently hired 9 political operatives and staffers - a strong sign that she may be prepping for a [third run](https://substack.com/redirect/4412deb2-ad05-4b30-80a6-d190b2211a6f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). I think that's a terrible idea, but she will hoover up a ton of energy, attention and money from the rest of the field if she does run.
I, personally, am animated by the prospect of getting middle-of-the-road, independent, pragmatic Senators out of Idaho and South Dakota - what a message that would send. [Todd Achilles](https://substack.com/redirect/6ba3791b-c53b-48a0-9f9d-07b5dac80491?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [Brian Bengs](https://substack.com/redirect/0a91bf7a-69c1-4df9-98f9-fb9e9138cec7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) are both military veterans and former college instructors. Even one of them making it to the Senate would signal a different kind of politics, and their votes could be pivotal in a closely divided Congress. I've donated to both of them and hope you do too.
Dems may claim that Americans have faith in them again because of a good result in November. A friend said to me, "Well, the pendulum is swinging, and you get the sense it will go farther and farther each time." The truth is that Americans are simply grasping for answers to a diminishing way of life. Our discontent will continue until something truly new emerges.
I interview Liam Petry, the creator of [Find My Politics](https://substack.com/redirect/9523dd0d-57e9-4e58-b3e9-f460dafbd0be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) this week on [Podcast](https://substack.com/redirect/699feb76-4a3c-4b04-9eee-2d499e6cbdf2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). body:
Derek, we want to pull back the curtain on our internal campaign analysis for a moment.

Derek, we want to pull back the curtain for a moment. You might think that the only major expenses for a campaign like ours are TV ads, a small handful of campaign staffers... and that’s it. **But that couldn’t be further from the truth.** As much as we wish this wasn’t the case, running an effective campaign in Pennsylvania is _extremely_ expensive. clean_body: Patriot, This is worrisome. Katie Hobbs is polling at 39%. Andy Biggs is at 37%. We 're closing the gap, but we have less than 45 days left on the clock. Arizona is THE battleground state. Here's what's at stake: If we lose AZ this year, we risk not having secure elections in 2028. We risk losing the Presidency. * We risk losing a decade because the next president will conduct the 2030 census. This is not to be alarmist. This is an all-hands-on-deck moment. We cannot lose Arizona. Closing a six-point gap in 45 days requires hard work. It happens by going door to door, meeting voters, and counting every ballot. We have the ballot chasers ready, but we're coming up short on funds. We're raising $94,000 this month to keep Turning Point PAC-funded ballot chasers in the field across Arizona every single day between now and Election Day. We can still win Arizona. But not without you. For America and for Charlie, Tyler Bowyer Executive Director Turning Point PAC Arizona Paid for by Turning Point PAC Arizona.
