_ _
What those hyper-partisan mapmakers and deep-pocketed challengers don't understand is that elections aren't won on drawing boards—they're won in our communities.

I know this district like the back of my hand. I’ve spent years working alongside the hardworking families of Osceola, Orange, and Polk counties. I’ve delivered key projects for the Heartland and the Coast. I’ve stood with our local small businesses, fought for lower costs and affordable healthcare, protected our local environment, had our farmers’ backs, and brought critical investments back home to Central Florida.

**I know what matters to our neighbors because I live it every day. I know how to talk to our voters, build strong coalitions, and deliver real results.**

But make no mistake: _**this is going to be one of the toughest fights of my political career.**_

body:
President Trump has set his sights on NC.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1785&source=&t=1&akid=4414%2E124072%2Eefb3qT) | | | |

Peter,
When President Trump posted a couple of late-night tirades on Truth Social earlier this year attacking Roy, **we knew we were in for a long race.**
When Trump’s attack dog, Stephen Miller, went on Fox News to spread misinformation about Roy and this election, **we knew we were getting to them.**
When Trump came to North Carolina to rally for our opponent, Michael Whatley, and launch character smear after character smear against Roy, **we knew they were nervous.**
When Vice President Vance followed up with ANOTHER rally here five days later, **we knew they were desperate.**
North Carolina is the best chance for Democrats to flip a GOP-held Senate seat in the country, but we can’t fight back against these attacks and win without your urgent support. [**_Please chip in._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1785&amount=5&t=8&akid=4414%2E124072%2Eefb3qT)
There are a lot of important Senate races happening this year, but Trump knows that if Republicans win in NC, they’ll block our shot at taking back the majority. It won’t matter what happens in other swing states. If Whatley wins here, that’s the entire ball game. The GOP will likely keep Senate control until 2029.
**The final FEC deadline of this election is right around the corner, and we’re falling behind on our goal. If we miss this goal, it’ll make it much harder to reach the voters we need to win – and this is a race we just can’t afford to lose.**
[**_Please, Peter, will you chip in $5 or more right now to help us defeat Trump and the GOP in North Carolina, flip this crucial seat and take back the Senate?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1785&amount=5&t=9&akid=4414%2E124072%2Eefb3qT)

Republicans have a massive fundraising advantage heading into these final weeks (as in hundreds of millions of dollars!), and outside groups are pouring dark money into key races all across the country. _This Wednesday, October 14th, is our very last FEC filing deadline before the midterms. After midnight, every federal campaign files a public fundraising report – and once they’re public, my MAGA opponent, national Republicans, and even those deep-pocketed groups will all read to see how we stack up._ I want to file a strong report – one that shows our deep grassroots support, a campaign built from the ground up, and the resources to win in November. What I don't want is a weak report – one that creates doubt for people who may have been sitting on the fence, and opens up space for our opponent to push even harder and pour money into the race. We cannot let that happen. **My team and I set a goal of raising another $12,000 online by Wednesday. That’s an ambitious goal, but I really believe that by working together, this team can get there. **

I’ll get straight to it: **I’m about to ask if you can make your first donation to help me defeat Lauren Boebert before our FINAL federally-mandated FEC fundraising deadline of the entire campaign.**

After Wednesday, federal law requires our campaign against Lauren Boebert to create a report of how much we’ve raised. That report then becomes public.
Reporters and pundits will dig into our report to judge the size and strength of our campaign. But it’s not just reporters.
Lauren Boebert and her Super PACs are going to scour our report to see if Boebert is still in danger. The national Democratic and Republican party are going to see if we have enough grassroots support that they need to prioritize this race.
And this is the absolute last chance for grassroots donors like you to show that you are 100% behind me to help me defeat Lauren Boebert this November.
We’re about to be under a microscope like never before, so we need a show of financial strength unlike any we’ve ever had.
That’s why we’ve set one of our biggest goals ever: **Raising another $500,000 from grassroots donors before this FINAL critical FEC deadline to show reporters, Boebert’s Super PACs, and the entire Republican and Democratic establishment that we’re still all-in to defeat Lauren Boebert in 2026.**

I’m not taking money from corporate PACs like Boebert is. Instead, I’m building a campaign funded entirely by grassroots donors like you.

A branch of the president's Super PAC, MAGA Inc., is spending big in Georgia, along with Senate Republicans' top Super PAC. Republicans have committed to spending over _**$70 million**_ to replace me with scandal-ridden bigot Mike Collins.
Now, a new poll from Quantus Insights shows me _statistically tied_ with my MAGA fanatic opponent.
This race is tightening, and with Georgians starting to vote tomorrow the timing is _not great_.
We need to respond and fight back immediately. My campaign doesn't accept contributions from corporate PACs or federal lobbyists. That means I rely on people like you, who are furious about what's being done to our country and want to make a difference by chipping in to send MAGA a powerful message and have my back.
**[So I 'm personally asking: Can you donate to my reelection campaign today? Jon

clean_body: Fellow American, I'll keep this message short and sweet. I've got to get back to work; it's a madhouse over here at the GOP. We're all working around the clock to make sure we win in November, and there's not a lot of time to spare anymore. This will be my final message... In just a few hours , we are finalizing our checklist before the midterm elections. Unfortunately, according to the report I just read, your name is still missing. I don't know if this is from a technical error or something else, but I was shocked. I've been following your supporter profile for quite a while, and you've always been there when it mattered. Maybe you've been taking a break from the internet, or maybe big tech has been blocking our messages recently. Whatever the case, I wanted to personally check in with you one last time before the midterm elections. Case File No DRT-ED-MOBILIZE · Special File · Quiet Mobilization
No One Declared War. So Why Is Washington Acting Like It’s Fighting One?
National emergencies. Emergency powers over the power grid. New rules forcing defense contractors to cut ties with Chinese suppliers. Hundreds of billions pulled back to U.S. soil. It looks a lot like economic mobilization, and almost nobody is calling it that.
Threat level 4/5 — Elevated
| | | | | | | | |
---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---
|
---
Turn on the news and you’ll hear about everything except this. But if you read the executive orders instead of the headlines, a pattern jumps out. Washington is using powers normally reserved for wartime, and it’s using them over and over.
The evidence board
| | The Paper Trail
---|---
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit A — July 20.** Trump signed an order making it much harder for defense contractors to buy critical minerals from prohibited foreign suppliers. The Pentagon must map where the materials for its weapons actually come from by January 2027.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit B — August 26.** The White House declared a national emergency over foreign-made equipment in America’s power grid, citing an “unusual and extraordinary foreign threat.” It linked the risk directly to rising demand from AI and defense production.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit C — the dependence.** The International Energy Agency found that China leads the refining of 19 out of 20 strategic minerals, with an average market share of about 70%.
| EVIDENCE
---
**Exhibit D — the money coming home.** Apple alone pledged hundreds of billions of dollars to expand manufacturing and production in the U.S. Other giants made similar promises.
| OUR THEORY
---
Put it together and it looks less like a series of separate policies and more like a single plan: secure the materials, secure the energy, bring production home. Governments only move this fast when they believe a confrontation is coming.
Why it matters to you
| | What Mobilization Does to Money
---|---
| →| **Trillions get redirected.** In every mobilization, government and private capital pour into a few strategic industries.
---|---
| →| **Some portfolios get hurt.** Companies that rely on cheap foreign supply chains face higher costs and new restrictions.
---|---
| →| **Others get a guaranteed customer.** Firms that supply what Washington now considers essential can see demand that lasts for years.
---|---
| ClassificationMobilizing
---
The last time America moved capital on this scale for national security, it reshaped the economy for a generation. The signs that it’s happening again are all in the public record, just not in the headlines.

A few analysts who have studied this closely say there is one force behind all of it, and that it will affect anyone with money in stocks or in the bank.If you’re responsible for your family’s wealth, this is worth understanding now.

October 12, 2026
In 2024, a Cornell female student - by her own admission - agreed to a threesome sexual encounter with two male students at the Chi Phi fraternity house. With her inhibitions diminished by both excessive alcohol and ketamine, she apparently agreed to more partners and one man involved texted to his friends, "free p***y," and by the time the encounter was over, she had sexual relations with a total of seven men - now dubbed The Cornell Seven.

According to [published reports](https://substack.com/redirect/46613d07-35b3-454b-bbb0-4f6e2ef15936?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), she initially did not regret the encounter. In fact, when referring to the event as a "gangbang" she [texted](https://substack.com/redirect/59e8f6f6-308c-4a79-9362-57a502d12da3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to one of the participants, "i don't think we should feel any shame for the part. our body our choice."

But this young lady, in spite of being brainwashed with the feminist view of sexual equality, soon learned that women who behave promiscuously, are not treated by society the same as men who do the same. Promiscuous men are called "studs" and "swordsmen." I will not repeat what promiscuous women are called.

She was soon ostracized by the other women in her sorority and disinvited to a Halloween Party sponsored by the Chi Phi fraternity where the incident occurred.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5536d041-e57a-4fc8-8f3f-e43dd9f52d81?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The now closed Chi Phi fraternity at Cornell University

The Cornell administration became aware of the incident and closed the Chi Phi fraternity while either suspending or expelling the seven men involved. The Cornell University Police Department asked the local District Attorney (DA) to investigate. But the DA [refused to press charges](https://substack.com/redirect/46613d07-35b3-454b-bbb0-4f6e2ef15936?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) against the men because:

"Jane Doe's [pseudonym for the woman's real name] sworn statement in November of 2024 did not allege that she was drugged against her will or gang raped. On the contrary, Jane Doe's statement described her participation in drug use and sexual conduct as voluntary, conscious, and consensual."

But the psychological wounds in this abused woman festered, and in 2026, she filed a civil suit against Cornell University, the national Chi Phi organization, her own sorority, and the local bar that served her alcohol even though she was underaged. And now politicians such as New York Attorney General Letitia James have joined the fray.

But when the dust settles, the real villains should be our cultural leaders who have turned sexual activity into a recreational sport and successfully silenced religious leaders who criticized this trend as unenlightened prudes.

Would men at an Ivy League institution engaged in such degenerate behavior in the 1950s? Would they have lined up to copulate with a drunk and drugged woman? Probably not.

So why is this happening now?

While Cornell University is feigning outrage at this behavior, its own health department [circulated a pamphlet ](https://substack.com/redirect/ec1b03d8-23c2-426f-80fb-30937fd3f7e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)to its students that encourages promiscuous behavior by promoting discussions of fetishes and group sex. In fact, one of the options listed in the pamphlet under "Relationship Models and Choices" are:

___ Sex of some kind(s) with two partners at a time
___ Sex of some kind(s) with three partners at a time
___ Sex of some kind(s) with more than three partners at a time

It will be interesting to see how Cornell University defends itself in this lawsuit.

But the main message of this event is that men are genetically programmed by evolution to be promiscuous. The goal of every species is to reproduce. And since men can impregnate more than one woman at a time, powerful men have had multiple wives, mistresses and harems so that they could do so. Women, on the other hand, can only carry the child of one man at a time. Biology 101.

This is why Christianity became so popular with women when promulgated two thousand years ago. Monogamous men are more reliable providers and do not infect their spouses with STDs (Sexually Transmitted Diseases).

Furthermore, some men will plop down $200 on their lunch break to copulate with a woman they has never seen before and not even share a common language, as long as the woman meets certain physical standards. Women, rarely if ever do this.

Why?

Because evolution has wired men and women's brains differently.

Yet, crazy feminists have convinced many young women that being promiscuous is natural and will make them feel fulfilled. It is not coincidence that this woman's statement "our body our choice" is the mantra of the pro-abortionists.

So, it is not surprising that even Ivy League men behave like dirtballs.

But as these men are about to find out, our legal system is about to enforce the same values that religion used to enforce. And perhaps this will be warning to other men not to behave like dirtballs.

clean_body: The New York Times last polled our race 3 months ago and found us down 7. This poll has swung 10 points since then. | = Peter, look at this: = In June, The New York Times /Siena poll had me trailing Greg Abbott by 7 points, 51% to 44%. Now, that same poll has me ahead, 49% to 46%. That's a 10-point swing in three months, from one of the most respected pollsters in the country. It's not a fluke, either. This is the third poll showing us ahead of Abbott, and it's the most recent one, taken after weeks of Abbott's attack ads flooding Texas airwaves. = The New York Times also ran a major story on the state of play in Texas. Read this: = Ten-to-one. Abbott has thrown everything he has at this race, and he still can't put it away. Wendy Davis put it this way in the same article: "People have vastly underestimated Gina. Dollar for dollar, she's running the best statewide campaign we've ever seen." That's what grassroots supporters like you have built $5 and $10 at a time. We haven't come close to matching Abbott's money, but every dollar has gone further than anyone thought it could. = The Times was also honest about what still stands in our way. Texas has 20 separate media markets, and national donors routinely pass the state over because reaching all of them is so expensive. And one in five Texas voters still don't know who I am. Here's what the last three months have taught us: the more Texans get to know me, the more this race moves. Every one of those voters is someone we can reach, but only if we have the resources to do it. Abbott has raised more than $106 million in this race, and he's going to keep spending it in the final month to drag this race back his way. We are 22 days from Election Day. The polls tell us this race can be won. What happens next depends on whether we have the financial resources to communicate our message to the voters who need to hear it. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = For 32 years, Texans have been told a Democrat can't win statewide. A 10-point swing after more than $70 million in spending against us says otherwise. Let's go take Texas back. body:
Urgent grassroots memo for your immediate attention:
#############################################

| | | | Peter, You've got both Ted and Ken writing to you today. It takes an **unprecedented threat** for the two of us to pull over on the campaign trail, sit down, and write you a joint message. _But _that threat_ is here - and it's more real than you could ever imagine_. clean_body: Our final FEC deadline is Wednesday – help us fight back. | | | | = Last week, President Trump teased that Russ Vought, the author of Project 2025, has a surprise for all of us before the midterms. As if we weren’t concerned enough about this election, he had to throw in an ominous tip that another very bad thing is headed our way. I have no idea what he’s talking about — but I know exactly who Russ Vought is, and I know exactly what Project 2025 has already done to this country. Earlier this year, the Heritage Foundation bragged that Trump and Republicans have already implemented more than half of their blueprint for remaking America into their dystopian, right-wing vision. Over the past two years, Trump and his Republican Party have driven up our prices, attacked our freedoms, and generally made our country less safe. In practice, that’s looked like: an illegal Iran war, ridiculously high tariffs, extreme cuts to health care, spikes in health insurance premiums, and cuts to food assistance. Oh, and don’t forget that Trump is stealing your tax dollars to peddle his propaganda, spending $20M in taxpayer funds to pay for ads about his so-called wins ahead of the midterms! This is what a government that works for the powerful, not the people, looks like. And if we want to change it, we have to win in November. subject: Why I refuse to leave anyone behind
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Mazie Hirono For Hawaii**
body:
|

---
_Peter, this is Mazie. Below is a message from Peggy Flanagan, who is running for Senate in Minnesota. Please read her message below, and I hope you will join me in standing with Peggy._
* * *
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141266089/652988700/-1377867294?refcode=AU_MKH_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20261012_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MTU3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNDU5N2I0OC03MWM2LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TN47Bv5Z15aoFlQpjsNjcm0fm-shzv6L8eI7QJ-fxa0=) Today is Indigenous Peoples' Day, and I wanted to take a moment with you. I am Ojibwe and a proud member of White Earth. My family is the Wolf Clan. The role of my clan is to never leave anyone behind — and that’s been my guiding principle throughout my entire life. Today, I’m thinking of all our relatives who survived residential boarding schools. I’m thinking of my father, who always spoke truth to power for the good of the Anishinaabe people. I’m thinking of my daughter — who just got her first jingle dress — and whether or not she will see Indigenous women in all parts of our government. Above all, Indigenous people are resilient. We have always been here, and we will always be here. Today, I’m celebrating that. **_But even now, there are no Native voices in the U.S. Senate._** It's high time that all our communities have a seat at the table. So I’m running to bring that resilience and strength to the United States Senate. **[On this Indigenous Peoples’ Day, will you split a donation between my campaign and Mazie Hirono to help us make history and build a future that serves all of us?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141266090/652988701/-1377867294?refcode=AU_MKH_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20261012_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MTU3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNDU5N2I0OC03MWM2LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TN47Bv5Z15aoFlQpjsNjcm0fm-shzv6L8eI7QJ-fxa0=)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Peggy Flanagan and Mazie Hirono will go through immediately:_ **** | | **[CHIP IN $10 NOW](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141266091/652988702/-1377867294?express_lane=true&amount=10&refcode=AU_MKH_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20261012_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MTU3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNDU5N2I0OC03MWM2LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TN47Bv5Z15aoFlQpjsNjcm0fm-shzv6L8eI7QJ-fxa0=)**

clean_body: | Peter, this is Mazie. Below is a message from Peggy Flanagan, who is running for Senate in Minnesota. Please read her message below, and I hope you will join me in standing with Peggy. = Today is Indigenous Peoples' Day, and I wanted to take a moment with you. I am Ojibwe and a proud member of White Earth. My family is the Wolf Clan. The role of my clan is to never leave anyone behind — and that’s been my guiding principle throughout my entire life. Today, I’m thinking of all our relatives who survived residential boarding schools. I’m thinking of my father, who always spoke truth to power for the good of the Anishinaabe people. I’m thinking of my daughter — who just got her first jingle dress — and whether or not she will see Indigenous women in all parts of our government. Above all, Indigenous people are resilient. We have always been here, and we will always be here. Today, I’m celebrating that. But even now, there are no Native voices in the U.S. Senate. It's high time that all our communities have a seat at the table. I know we've been reaching out a lot, but by 11:59 p.m. on Wednesday, we really need to hit our $2 million final FEC goal before the election. Right now, we're falling short, but if another 10,000 grassroots donors contribute before midnight, we can close the gap.
Missing this goal is simply not an option. Let me explain:
Republicans are spending big on winning this Senate seat -- more than $23 million so far. Missing our goal means we can't keep our own ads on the air. It means that we let Sen. Marshall and his corporate PAC donors have the last word.
In the few months since this campaign began, I've learned this: **In a tight race like ours,**_**every dollar counts**_**.**
We set monthly fundraising goals like this one to folks like you with full faith that this incredible group of supporters will step up. **[Please, I am counting on you to pitch in any amount toward our goal of $2 million before 11:59 p.m. on Wednesday.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/cd9264e3-ce0f-4cae-8c5a-8e484f397668?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Thank you in advance for supporting our movement to fight the chaos and corruption in Washington and restore common sense and decency to our politics.
With gratitude,
Adam

Steve Robinson joined Jack Posobiec on Human Events Daily to talk Maine's Senate race and Medicaid fraud. Robinson called Senator Susan Collins favored against Troy Jackson but said it will be the closest race she has had. He walked through Jackson's record as Senate president, including his switch on three gun control bills after his son's lobbying firm, Resurgam Group, got a $50,000 contract with the Maine Gun Safety Coalition. On the Ilhan Omar raid, Robinson said Maine and Minnesota fraud is "really just one scandal," and described being on site when Homeland Security searched the Lewiston office of the Gateway Community Services CEO.

clean_body: I don't have much time. The clock to November 3rd is ticking down fast. | Fellow Patriot - I'm on the campaign trail, but took a break to record this just for you: Election Day is less than 22 days away, and Annie Andrews and her liberal allies have raised over $20 million to take this Senate seat. That money is coming from coastal elites and national Democrat groups who see South Carolina as their next pickup. They want a seat that's been safely conservative for years to vote with Chuck Schumer instead. This seat is at risk. If Republicans assume South Carolina is safe, Democrats could flip it in November. latest step in their ludicrous, partisan investigation into my immigration

With this obviously political investigation, Trump is telling his voters:
"Ignore the price of gas, ignore the war in Iran, ignore that you’re
losing your healthcare — we want you to get angry about this instead.”

Throughout his presidency, Trump has weaponized the DOJ to target his
political opponents, manufacturing charges that have been roundly
dismissed by court after court. And I’m not even the first member of
Congress to be targeted. The point is to waste everyone’s time and
resources, and generate negative headlines for his opponents.

I will repeat what I have long said: This is a ludicrous investigation,
and Trump’s escalation is only further proof that he is willing to use the
power of the federal government to try to intimidate and silence anyone
who stands up to him. It’s up to us to make sure it doesn’t work.
